## Objective
When a user request arrives, offer it only to ambulances inside a radius around the pickup, grow that radius when nobody accepts, assign the first driver who accepts, and take the assignment back if that ambulance has not moved 10 metres within 2 minutes.

## Context
The dispatcher board is madadplus-web, on branch Webtest. madadplus-web/app.js and madadplus-web/style.css already have uncommitted ambulance-icon work. Leave that work in place.

The board already shows the pickup and assigns a unit through POST /api/v1/emergency-requests/:requestId/assign. Comments in app.js name src/dispatch.js as the backend that chooses the nearest free unit. The driver app is the place a driver accepts a request. madad_plus_mobile is in this checkout and has no driver screens in lib. The driver UI may be on another branch.

The pickup is the user location. Do not build a second requester app.

Locked numbers:
- Start at 2000 metres.
- If the circle contains no ambulance, grow it at once by 1000 metres.
- If the circle contains one or more ambulances and none accept within 30 seconds, grow it by 1000 metres.
- Stop growing at 15000 metres.
- The driver who accepts has 2 minutes to move.
- Moving means the ambulance position is at least 10 metres from the position recorded when the assignment succeeded.
- If those 2 minutes end and the ambulance is still under 10 metres, unassign that driver. Offer the same request again to every other ambulance that was inside the radius at the moment of that assignment. Do not shrink the radius. Do not offer this request to the driver who just timed out.
- The first accepted assignment wins. A later accept does not replace it.

## Target state
The dispatcher map draws one circle around the active pickup at the radius currently in use, and the circle updates when that radius changes. Hospital pins stay the size they are now. Ambulance icons keep their current zoom scale.

The driver who is inside the circle gets an incoming-request screen and can accept it. After a successful assignment, that driver sees a 2 minute timer and how far the ambulance is from the 10 metre mark. A driver excluded after a timeout does not see that same request again. A driver whose accept loses sees a clear refusal.

At 15000 metres with no accept, growing stops and the request stays unassigned. The dispatcher shows that the search reached 15 km.

## What happens now

In src/server.js, startSearch stores a search at radius 0 and calls growSearch. growSearch sets the radius to 300 metres the first time, then adds 500 metres on each later call. It emits search.updated to the dispatcher immediately, so the red ring appears at once. It then calls runSearchStep, which waits SEARCH_RING_MS (15000) and only then runs countSearch.

countSearch is the pass that finds free ambulances inside the current radius and emits request.offered to each driver's socket room. The driver app shows the card from that event with no extra wait: EmergencySocketService listens for request.offered, and _receiveDriverOffer in madad_plus_mobile/lib/services/emergency_request_state.dart stores the offer and calls notifyListeners.

The dispatcher can show the ring for 15 seconds before any driver is sent the card. That is the gap in the two screenshots: the ring is already drawn, and the driver card arrives only after countSearch runs.

## Required behavior

A driver gets the card in the same pass that finds that driver's ambulance inside the current radius. Run that pass when the radius is set, for the opening 300 metre ring and for each later growth. Do not wait 15 seconds after drawing a ring before checking who is inside it.

Keep these values as they are: SEARCH_START_METRES 300, SEARCH_GROW_METRES 500, SEARCH_RING_MS 15000. The 15 seconds remains the time between one radius and the next larger radius. It also remains the final wait after every free ambulance has already been offered, before giveUpSearch. That final wait is time for a driver to tap Accept.

An ambulance outside the current radius is still offered only when a later radius includes it. Do not add a new location watcher, a new timer, or a poll. Use the check that already exists.

The payload, the socket event name, and who receives the offer stay as they are. A driver who was already offered is not offered again. Decline, accept, assignFromSearch, and giveUpSearch keep their current results.

- SEARCH_START_METRES, SEARCH_GROW_METRES, and SEARCH_RING_MS

## Goal
A worker cannot be paid, and a user cannot rate the worker, until the worker's camera reads a live code from the user's phone and the server accepts that both phones are near the job.

## What happens now
Complete job calls finishProviderWork in madad_plus_mobile/lib/services/emergency_request_state.dart. That sets the payment text, opens Payment received, and emits domestic.work_finished. The user phone handles that event in _receiveUserBooking and opens the rating screen. src/server.js relays domestic.work_finished with no check.

The screens already in the app stay. Active job has Provider notes, Upload photos, and Complete job. The user screen during the job says Service in progress and Job underway. After a real completion the worker still sees Payment received, You were paid Rs. …, From …, and Back to home. The user still sees Service complete, the existing rating question, Your rating helps other customers choose., Optional service review, Submit rating, and Skip. Do not change any of those words.

qr_flutter, mobile_scanner, and geolocator are already in madad_plus_mobile/pubspec.yaml. Use them. Do not add another package. A domestic job already has lat and lng on DomesticBooking.

## Flow
Start job stays as it is. The user keeps seeing Job underway.

When the worker taps Complete job, two things happen together. The worker's camera opens on its own. The user leaves Job underway and sees the code screen. Tell the user's phone with a new socket event. Do not use domestic.work_finished for that moment, and do not open payment or rating from it.

The code screen shows a QR code for this job. The server replaces that code every 5 seconds. The phone asks for the current code on that same interval and draws the new code in place. The screen entrance does not play again on each refresh. The server accepts the current code and the one just before it, so a scan that crosses a refresh still counts. Any older code is rejected.

While that screen is up, the user phone sends its own location with each code refresh. The server stores that reading with the code. The worker's scan sends the scanned text and the worker's own location. It does not send the user's coordinates. The server uses the stored user reading.

Accept the scan only when all of these are true. The code is the current one or the previous one. The job has lat and lng. The stored user reading and the worker reading are each within 100 metres of that point. Both readings are from the current code window. If the job has no coordinates, reject the scan.

On acceptance the server emits domestic.work_finished. That is the only path to the existing payment screen and the existing rating screen. A rejected scan leaves the camera up and the code on the user's phone. The worker can leave the camera and return to Active job. The user can leave the code screen and return to Job underway. Neither return pays the worker or opens the rating.

Keep the current code, the previous code, and the latest user location in server memory for that request. Do not add a table.

## The code screen
Match the left phone in the reference: a warm yellow full-bleed background, one white rounded card, a circle sitting on the top edge of the card, the customer's name under that circle, the QR code centered in the card, and one sentence under the code. Use the customer's name already stored on the booking. There is no user photo in the app, so the circle shows the first letter of that name. The sentence under the code is: Hold this up for the worker to scan.

Do not add the orange phone, a share row, a download button, or a profile photo. Do not write the new words as two short sentences, and do not join a label to a value with a dot or a middle dot.

The screen settles in with a critically damped spring, damping 1.0 and response about 0.4, with no bounce. It enters and leaves on the same path. A reduced-motion setting uses a short fade instead. The Complete job press still responds on press, the way the existing press scale does. Leave the other screens on the current theme.

If the camera permission is missing, the worker stays off the payment screen and the sentence is: The camera is needed to scan the code. If the server rejects the scan, the sentence is: The scan did not count. Try again.

## Done when
Complete job no longer opens Payment received or the rating screen by itself. The user sees the yellow code screen when completion starts. A current code with both readings inside 100 metres opens the existing payment screen and the existing rating screen. A code from two steps back is rejected. A reading beyond 100 metres is rejected. A missing job location is rejected. A user location supplied by the worker is ignored.

Update the widget test that taps Complete job and expects You were paid Rs. 2500. Add a server test for the five accept and reject cases above. Show the test output. This phone talks to the deployed server, so a local edit will not change a live job until that server is running this code. Say that if you have not pointed both phones at the server you just edited.

The reply recorded:

The TECNO camera has no action that returns scanned text to another app.

## What that camera can return

`com.transsion.camera` only answers photo and video actions: `IMAGE_CAPTURE`, `STILL_IMAGE_CAMERA`, `VIDEO_CAPTURE`, and `VIDEO_CAMERA`. A photo action gives back a picture file. A video action gives back a video file. None of them give back the text inside a QR code.

## What the QR reader does

The QR reader is a screen inside the camera app. It reads the code and keeps the result there: plain text, or a copy banner when the code is a link. That screen never calls Madad+ with the text.

## The action that would hand the text back

Android does have one action for this, `com.google.zxing.client.android.SCAN`. The scanned text comes back in `SCAN_RESULT`. On your phone that action has no app registered. The check printed `No activity found`.

## What Madad+ can do

Madad+ can open the camera. After that open, the camera does not call back. Putting a link in the QR only changes the banner to "copy". The code still stays in the camera.

Next: reply `in-app camera` or `leave the banner`.

Madad+ is a phone app and a dispatcher map for calling an ambulance or a home-service worker. The request goes out to people inside a widening ring, and the first one who accepts takes the job. The user asked:

use humanizer.mdc to tell me what the gist of my project is. keep it between 1 to 3 sentences. be accurate

The reply recorded:

Madad+ is a phone app for requesting an ambulance or booking a plumber, electrician, or carpenter. An ambulance request goes out to nearby drivers inside a circle that grows from the pickup, and a dispatcher follows the same call on a map. A scan checks that the caller and the worker are at the job before payment, and if the caller's phone loses its connection, the app lists nearby hospitals with numbers to call.
